name: Macharhat–Dohabora Chuk National Highway
significance: NH 715K is a branch of NH 715. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Macharhat to Dohabora Chuk, and it meets NH 715 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 715 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Amguri to Lokra
